name: policy-glossary-check
description: Warn when forbidden or outdated glossary terms appear in core requirements/architecture/customization docs.

hooks.command: sh -lc 'changed=$(git diff --name-only -- PRD.md ARCHITECTURE.md AGENTS.md .github/instructions .github/prompts .github/agents); if [ -z "$changed" ]; then exit 0; fi; violations=$(rg -n "SpiceDB|ZedToken|zedToken|line-of-business" PRD.md ARCHITECTURE.md AGENTS.md .github/instructions .github/prompts .github/agents 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$violations" ]; then echo "POLICY-GLOSSARY-CHECK: Found forbidden or outdated terms. Use canonical project terminology."; echo "$violations"; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
